# Income War Map Revenue Planning

Capability ID: income-war-map-v1
Commercial state: hold
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/income-war-map-v1/index.html
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- help me make more money
- find revenue opportunities
- build me an income plan
- side hustle ideas for my situation
- revenue war map
- income strategy
- how can I increase my income

## Problem

A person needs a structured revenue plan based on their real constraints rather than generic opportunity lists.

## Inputs

User-provided income, expenses, debt, skills, available time, risk tolerance, work context, location and revenue target.

## Outputs

Personalized planning opportunities, modeled revenue/startup/time/risk estimates, prioritized missions and progress tracking.

## Pricing

Planned tiers exist, but new membership checkout is currently paused while entitlement synchronization is hardened.

## Invocation and authority

Discoverable capability only. Paid membership checkout is disabled pending entitlement hardening.

Planning estimates are not guarantees or individualized investment, tax, legal or credit advice. No checkout should be initiated while billing is paused.

Payment authority: Stripe legacy adapter; checkout paused

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
